QuestInfo.name: Their Identity
QuestInfo.0: You wonder who <they> are why the residents wouldn't talk to you because of <them>... Talk to the #bcorpulent man in black#k.
QuestInfo.1: #p2152016#, a watchman dressed in black, says they are the ones who rule this town now and demands that you pay a fee if you want to stay in this town. He's a rather unpleasant man, but you can tell he isn't lying. You don't seem to have any other option but to find the item #p2152016# wants.\n\n#i4000603# #t4000603# #b#c4000603# / 40#k
QuestInfo.2:
#p2152016# is pleased when you hand him 40 #t4000603#s. He nods--a short, arrogant motion--and says you can stay in this town.

Time to go back to #bFerdi#k.

0.0: Hey, you look new. You're not from around here, are you? If you're an outsider, you should have made your presence known to me immediately. What? Who am I? You don't know the great #p2152016#?
0.1: Open your eyes and listen carefully! #rThis town is under the rule of us Black Wings#k! You have to follow our orders! You understand that?

yes.0: Okay, first off... If you want to be in this town, you have to pay a special fee! 30 million Mesos should be enough! What? You don't have enough money? Then you'll have to make it up with hard labor!
yes.1: If you go to the strolling path to the right of town, you'll see some #r#o2150002#s#k. Bring me #b40 #t4000603#s#k and I will consider it your fee. Pretty good deal, RIGHT?

no.0: You don't understand? Then get out of here!

1.0: Huh? I've never seen you before... Oh wait! You're that outsider! Did you bring the #t4000603#s? Let me see if you brought enough.

yes.0: Ah... You got all 40. This should be enough to satisfy #p2154002#... Okay! I give you permission to be here. However, you have to obey what we tell you. If you disobey the Black Wings, you'll be expelled immediately.
yes.1: What? If you wanna make small talk, then go make it with #bFerdi#k! \rHe's to the #bleft#k.

item.0: Have you not brought the #b40 #t4000603#s#k yet? Hurry up and pay your fee! Head immediately to the strolling path to the right of town!
